data.title: 伊地知虹夏 · 打烊舞台台阶的心动独坐
data.description: 演出彻底散场、全场灯光熄灭后的LiveHouse里，唯有一束暖红的侧光照亮舞台台阶。虹夏把鼓槌放在膝头，脱掉运动外套，身穿无袖乐队红T恤并肩坐下。微风掠过她标志性的大呆毛与金色单侧侧马尾，她揉着酸痛的手腕，转过头露出只给一个人的娇憨笑颜。
data.action: sitting on stage steps, drumsticks on lap, massaging wrist, sweet smile
data.lighting: single warm red stage floodlight in dark hall
data.promptProse: Sitting on the empty LiveHouse stage steps after closing time, Ijichi Nijika relaxes in her sleeveless red band tee. A single warm stage light highlights her golden side-ponytail and iconic dorito ahoge as she massages her drum-tired wrist with a sweet, affectionate grin.
data.animaCaption: Nijika relaxing on the dark stage steps after the band performance. Warm stage light reveals her face, drumsticks and the steps around her.
